title: Section 680.1 – Add an Informational Note to Section 680.1 to read as follows:
officialText:
Informational Note: Refer to Section 47 of Article 165 of the New York City Health Code, for illumination level,
lighting, emergency lighting illumination, wiring for public and commercial use.
